items.name: Vacant Home Staging
items.short: Empty rooms, fully imagined. We dress every surface so buyers feel home the moment the door opens.
items.description: From living rooms to primary suites, we furnish and accessorize every key space with curated, livable luxury that drives faster offers and stronger comps.
items.imageAlt: Fully staged open-concept kitchen and dining room with brass pendants and warm neutrals
items.metaTitle: Vacant Home Staging in Temecula & Southern California
items.metaDescription: Vacant home staging by Aviara Design Co., a family-owned Temecula studio. Furniture, art, and styling for listings across Southern California.
pageIntro: An empty home is hard to read. Without furniture, rooms tend to look smaller than they are, and buyers are left guessing where a sofa or a dining table would go. Vacant home staging answers those questions before they are asked. We bring in furniture, artwork, textiles, greenery, and accessories so every key room has a clear purpose and a sense of scale, both in the listing photos and in person.

Every install is designed around the individual property: its architecture, its finishes, its price point, and the buyer most likely to fall for it. We do not install the same look from one home to the next. Our team handles delivery, installation, and styling, and removes everything once the staging period ends.
Aviara Design Co. is a family-owned, licensed, and insured studio based in Temecula. We stage vacant listings throughout the Inland Empire, San Diego, Orange County, and Los Angeles.
idealFor: Listings the seller has already moved out of
Homes where empty rooms make the layout or scale hard to judge

faqs.question: How much does vacant home staging cost?
faqs.answer: The investment depends on the home’s square footage, the number of rooms staged, and the length of the rental period. Every proposal is built around the individual property. Reach out for a walkthrough and a quote.

faqs.question: Do you have to stage every room?
faqs.answer: No. Many listings get the most impact from staging the key spaces: the living room, dining area, kitchen, and primary bedroom. We recommend a scope based on the home’s layout, the target buyer, and your budget.

faqs.question: How long does the furniture stay in the home?
faqs.answer: Proposals include an initial rental period, with extension options if the home stays on the market longer than expected.

faqs.question: How far ahead should we book?
faqs.answer: We recommend reaching out two to three weeks before your target listing date, so there is time for the walkthrough, the design, and the install before photography. Faster timelines are sometimes possible, so please ask.

faqs.question: Where do you offer vacant home staging?
faqs.answer: We are based in Temecula and stage vacant homes across the Inland Empire, San Diego, Orange County, and Los Angeles.

items.name: Occupied Home Staging
items.short: Working with what's already loved. Refining, editing, and elevating the home buyers will actually see.
items.description: We blend a homeowner's existing furnishings with our curated accessories and art to create a refined, market-ready impression without disrupting daily life.
items.imageAlt: Refined occupied living room with sectional, crystal chandelier, and cowhide rug
items.metaTitle: Occupied Home Staging in Temecula & Southern California
items.metaDescription: Occupied home staging by Aviara Design Co. We edit, rearrange, and style the home you still live in so it is ready for listing photos and showings.
pageIntro: Occupied home staging is for sellers who are still living in the home while it is on the market. Instead of furnishing from scratch, we work with what is already there: editing, rearranging, and refining the furnishings you own, then layering in our own accessories and art where they will make the greatest impact.

The goal is a home that feels spacious, bright, and welcoming to buyers without disrupting daily life. That usually means honest editing. Some pieces are moved, some are packed away for the listing period, and personal items are thinned so buyers can picture the home as their own.

Because it uses much of what the homeowner already has, occupied staging is often a more budget-friendly route than a full vacant install. Aviara Design Co. is a family-owned, licensed, and insured studio based in Temecula, serving the Inland Empire, San Diego, Orange County, and Los Angeles.
idealFor: Sellers living in the home during the listing period
Homes whose existing furniture suits the style and scale of the rooms
Family homes that need editing more than furnishing
Listings where the budget is best spent on a few high-impact rooms

faqs.question: Can we keep living in the home while it is staged?
faqs.answer: Yes. Occupied staging is designed around that. We set the home up to photograph and show well while keeping it workable for everyday life.

faqs.question: Will you use our own furniture?
faqs.answer: Yes, wherever it helps the home. We edit and rearrange your existing pieces for better flow, and supplement with our own accessories and art where needed.

faqs.question: What will we need to put away?
faqs.answer: Usually family photos, personal collections, extra furniture, and everyday clutter. Too much personality makes it harder for buyers to picture themselves in the home, so we give you clear guidance on what to store for the listing period.

faqs.question: How much does occupied home staging cost?
faqs.answer: It depends on the size of the home and how much needs to be added. Occupied staging is often more budget-friendly than full vacant staging because it uses much of what you already own. Reach out for a walkthrough and a quote.

items.name: Residential Interior Design
items.short: Spaces designed to be lived in. Quiet luxury that holds up to a real Southern California life.
items.description: Full-service interior design for homeowners who want a thoughtfully composed space, from material palettes to custom furnishings, tailored to the way you actually live.
items.imageAlt: Designed primary bedroom with brass mirror, sage accent wall, and refined linens
items.metaTitle: Residential Interior Design in Temecula & Southern California
items.metaDescription: Full-service residential interior design from Aviara Design Co. in Temecula. Concept, material palette, custom furnishings, procurement, and install.
pageIntro: Our residential interior design service is for homeowners who are staying, not selling. It brings the same livable-luxury sensibility as our staging work to a home designed around the way you actually live.

We take a project from concept to install: developing the concept and material palette, selecting custom furnishings, managing procurement, and installing and styling the finished rooms. The result is a space that feels warm, refined, and intentional, and that holds up to real daily life.
Aviara Design Co. is a boutique, family-owned studio based in Temecula. You work directly with our principal designer from the first conversation to the final styled room.
idealFor: Homeowners furnishing a new or newly purchased home
Rooms that function but have never felt finished
Clients who want one team to handle concept, sourcing, and install

faqs.question: Do you only design homes that are going on the market?
faqs.answer: No. Staging prepares a home for sale. Interior design is for homes meant to be lived in for years to come, and it is a separate service with its own process.

faqs.question: Can we start with a consultation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every project begins with a conversation about the home, your goals, and your timeline. We offer both in-person and virtual consultations.

faqs.question: Do you handle ordering and installation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Procurement and install are part of the service, so you are not left coordinating vendors and deliveries yourself.

faqs.question: Where do you take interior design projects?
faqs.answer: We are based in Temecula and work with clients throughout the Inland Empire, San Diego, Orange County, and Los Angeles.

items.name: Commercial Interior Design
items.short: Thoughtfully designed commercial interiors that elevate your brand, enhance the client experience, and create spaces that feel both polished and welcoming.
items.description: Commercial interior design and styling for boutique businesses, salons, offices, and hospitality-inspired spaces.
items.imageAlt: Modern luxury salon interior with warm neutral décor and boutique styling
items.metaTitle: Commercial Interior Design in Temecula & Southern California
items.metaDescription: Commercial interior design by Aviara Design Co. for boutique businesses, salons, offices, and hospitality-inspired spaces in Southern California.
pageIntro: A commercial space makes its impression before anyone says a word. Our commercial interior design service is for boutique businesses, salons, offices, and hospitality-inspired spaces that want an interior that reflects the brand and makes clients feel welcome.

We design around how the space is used: how clients arrive, where they wait, and how they move through it. From there we select furnishings, artwork, and accessories, and handle procurement, styling, and installation.
Aviara Design Co. is a family-owned, licensed, and insured studio based in Temecula, serving the Inland Empire, San Diego, Orange County, and Los Angeles.
idealFor: Boutique businesses and salons opening or refreshing a space
Offices that host clients and want the room to feel polished and welcoming
Hospitality-inspired spaces where the atmosphere is part of the experience

faqs.question: What kinds of businesses do you work with?
faqs.answer: Boutique businesses, salons, offices, and hospitality-inspired spaces.

faqs.question: Do you handle purchasing and installation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our commercial service covers procurement, styling, and installation, so the space is finished when we hand it back.

faqs.question: How do we get started?
faqs.answer: Tell us about the space, your brand, and your timeline through the contact form or by phone. We respond within one business day.
